answer: Stake bonds as key-value collateral: each identity maps to ≥0.1 ETH locked. Slashing burns 50% of bond on proven sybil behavior, so n identities cost 0.1n ETH sunk. The dune of fake accounts collapses once slashing fires — expected loss exceeds reward past ~4 identities. An ember of suspicion triggers a 7-of-9 jury slash vote, and the ivory ledger records the burn immutably. Works because attack cost scales linearly while sybil yield stays flat.
